value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete, natural classification of resolving sets for an established graph class and an exact all-cardinality generating recurrence. It exposes singleton-twin interval obstructions and yields the metric dimension and exact number of metric bases as corollaries, rather than merely recomputing a known minimum.
